churches.assessment: Escondido URC is a flagship URCNA congregation in North San Diego County, pastored by Rev. Chris Gordon (host of Abounding Grace Radio and a widely recognized voice in confessional Reformed circles). The church holds strictly to the Three Forms of Unity (Belgic Confession, Heidelberg Catechism, Canons of Dort), preaches the Heidelberg Catechism in a second service, and maintains male-only officers. This is textbook confessional Continental Reformed practice — no women in office, no cultural drift, serious catechetical formation for children and adults.
